text:
Samir: Short thread to capture the few unanswered hiring/org Qs from today's all-hands. I'll answer the ones we promised to follow up on.
Priya: Thanks Samir. Quick clarifier: when you say "reprioritize hiring", does that mean we create a "temporary capacity pool" or just stop opening new reqs?
Samir: We'll create a small temporary capacity pool (~8 FTE equivalents) that product/eng leads can tap for customer-critical work. New non-strategic reqs should be held until the triage window closes.
Diego: For teams depending on new hires to hit quarterly roadmap commits, can they request short-term contractors from that pool?
Priya: Yes — contractors can be approved from the pool for up to 3 months if tied to committed deliverables. Managers must submit a 1-paragraph justification and expected outcomes.
Evelyn: Any changes to internal mobility or rotation programs? Some ICs were planning cross-team rotations.
Priya: Rotations still supported. We're launching an "opt-in rotation" track: teams can post 2-3 month shadow slots. Those count toward redeploy consideration if a headcount shift happens.
Harpreet: What about manager hires and promotion pipelines? Are we pausing TL->Manager conversions?
Samir: Promotions continue as normal. Manager hiring is scoped down: we'll only open new manager reqs if they are critical to scale (pods >10) or are replacements for promoted ICs.
Diego: Interviewing standards — will recruiting change the scorecard or interview loop?
Priya: Slight tightening on scorecards: we'll emphasize cross-functional breadth (T-shaped) and delivery track record. For non-core roles, recruiting may propose a condensed loop (1-panel + takehome) to speed decisions.
Evelyn: If my pod loses a req, what's the timeline for redeploy vs separation?
Priya: Step 1: 7-business-day internal match period. Step 2: if no match, two-week transition support + separation if necessary. HR will run targeted office hours for affected folks.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: HR drop-in hours Wednesday 4pm PT and Friday 9am PT. Invite posted in #people-ops.
Harpreet: Is there a transparent list of which reqs are in the temporary pool vs paused?
Priya: We'll publish a short spreadsheet (read-only) with req status and rationale by EOD tomorrow. Managers can DM for clarifications or to request exceptions.
Diego: Exceptions process — will those be public? How fast can we get approval for SLA-blocking hires?
Samir: Exceptions are handled via a short form (2 lines + owner sign-off). SLA-blocking cases get a 48h fast-track review; revenue-critical gets same-day if the exec sponsor signs off.
Evelyn: What signals will be used to re-open paused reqs? Roadmap slippage? Revenue thresholds?
Samir: We will re-open based on a combination of runway cadence, delivery risk (backlog aging and SLA impact), and upcoming committed revenue events. People Ops + Finance will publish criteria.
Priya: Recruiters: please pause creating new public postings for non-strategic reqs. Continue active pipelines only for roles marked STRATEGIC.
Harpreet: Will this impact referral bonuses or internal mobility bonus timelines?
Priya: Referral payouts remain unchanged for hires that close. Internal mobility bonus timing shouldn't change, but recruiting will confirm per-case.
Diego: Any proactive training or upskilling budget to help redeployed folks bridge skill gaps?
Priya: Yes — a small redeployment learning fund will be available for certifications or short courses tied to an approved internal move.
Samir: Thanks — keeping this concise so teams have a public reference. If you need a private conversation, DM Priya or me. We'll post the pool spreadsheet and the exception form link here once live. :white_check_mark:
